freshVisualFirstPass.detail: All 24 fresh source/battle complete-face and body slices actually inspected, covering 13 clips at six phases, front and side. Thunder Drake lower cheek, snout and chin shear relative to its brow during secondary idle, recoil, attack and tilted defeat; the jaw becomes pinched in defeat. Horns, wing membranes, tail and four limbs remain connected in these raw clips. Two actual Lightning Strike windup/impact sheets inspected; support toe penetration also needs a separate final technique check. Original and 2.5 exposure copies retained.
